citation: United States v. Forrester, 512 F.3d 500 (9th Cir. 2008) (leading 9th Circuit case on URL content question); In re Application for Pen Register and Trap/Trace Device with Cell Site Location Authority, 396 F. Supp. 2d 747 (S.D. Tex. 2005)
court: United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit (Forrester); United States District Court, S.D. Texas (Application)
statute_version_applicable: 18 U.S.C. §§3121-3127 (post-PATRIOT Act version); compared with 18 U.S.C. §§2511, 2701
rule_established: IP addresses and email header routing information = pen register (no content, no §2511/§2701 protection); URL paths potentially content — debate unresolved in 9th Circuit; distinction critical for evidence collection and damages theory in SIM swap account access cases
verification_note: Verify 512 F.3d 500 citation; research current 9th Circuit position on URL content question before filing; note this is a contested and evolving area
